scripts.dev:all: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n core,api,worker -c cyan,blue,green "pnpm --filter @chronicler/core dev" "pnpm --filter api dev" "pnpm --filter worker dev"
scripts.dev:mcp: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n core,mcp -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @chronicler/core dev" "pnpm --filter chronicler-mcp dev"
scripts.dev:mcp-full: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n core,worker,mcp -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @chronicler/core dev" "pnpm --filter worker dev" "PORT=3001 pnpm --filter chronicler-mcp dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chronicler/core build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter worker build && pnpm --filter mcp build
